subject.title: [Bug]: Unscheduled reminder guard fires for isolated-session crons + counter lost during compaction

question: Should maintainers adopt or refresh the open conflicting fork PR for this issue, close it and allow a fresh focused OpenClaw PR, or keep waiting on the fork author?
rationale: Current main still has the bug, but an exact external closing PR already exists and is conflicting, so an automated duplicate fix would ignore an existing contributor path and the repository’s linked-PR handling.

options.title: Close or replace the fork PR
options.body: Close the stale conflicting fork PR if it is not going to be adopted, then allow a new narrow target-repo fix for this issue.

options.title: Adopt and refresh the fork PR
options.body: Have a maintainer or the fork author rebase the existing PR and prove the isolated-session plus compaction retry paths before merge.

options.title: Keep waiting on the fork PR
options.body: Leave this issue paired with the current fork PR, accepting that the bug remains open until that branch is refreshed.

recommendation.title: Close or replace the fork PR
recommendation.body: Close the stale conflicting fork PR if it is not going to be adopted, then allow a new narrow target-repo fix for this issue.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter committed the original guard fix and extracted the guard helper, making him the best history-backed owner for the linked-PR ownership decision.
